title: Classify: Use Case Generalization
scenario: A Customer can execute "Pay for Order". In modern systems, this can be fulfilled in several specific ways: "Pay via Credit Card" or "Pay via PayPal". Each specific payment type is a specialization of the generic "Pay for Order" use case.
goal: Classify the relationship between the specific payment methods and the generic payment use case using Use Case Generalization.
learningObjective: Learn Use Case Generalization. Just like actors, use cases can specialize other use cases. The arrow points from the specific child use case to the abstract parent use case.
hints: Customer connects to the general "Pay for Order" via Association.
Pay via Credit Card is a specialized form of Pay for Order. Draw Generalization pointing to "Pay for Order".
Pay via PayPal is also a specialized form. Draw Generalization pointing to "Pay for Order".
solutionExplanation: Use Case Generalization means the child use case inherits the behavior and meaning of the parent use case, providing a concrete implementation.

solutions.description: Customer associates with Pay for Order; subcases generalize it
